description: Measures whether a text is by the SAME HAND as three reference texts pasted in the call. No account, no credits, nothing stored. Exactly 3 references of 100+ words each, in DIFFERENT registers, and a text of 50+ words (150 to leave low confidence). Returns a calibrated PROBABILITY, its label and four stylometric dimensions (not a breakdown of the probability). `probability: null` with `unavailable` is a measured abstention; only `embedding_layer` is an outage on our side. Not verify_authorship, which uses the account’s kept voice. For that, a Kaneme account at https://kaneme.com and the authenticated MCP connection.

question.description: human = this person vs an AI (default) · author = this person vs another human.

samples.description: Exactly 3 texts by the person, 100+ words each, different registers.

text.description: Text to attribute (50+ words), not taken from the references (self_overlap).
